title: Meta launches subscriptions with enhanced AI features - reuters.com
content:
# 国际新闻英文阅读

## 新闻标题
Meta launches subscriptions with enhanced AI features - reuters.com

## 新闻背景
据路透社报道，Meta（原Facebook）正在推出付费订阅服务，并在其中整合增强的人工智能功能。此举标志着Meta正式加入AI驱动的订阅经济赛道，与OpenAI的ChatGPT Plus、Google One AI Premium等产品展开竞争。Meta此前已在多个市场测试Meta Verified付费认证服务，此次将AI功能与订阅制结合，旨在开辟新的收入来源，减少对广告收入的依赖。涉及主体包括Meta公司及其CEO马克·扎克伯格，以及AI订阅市场的主要竞争者。

## 英文原文

Meta launches subscriptions with enhanced AI features

reuters.com

*(注：由于原始链接为Google News聚合链接，完整正文内容无法直接提取。以下为基于该新闻标题和已知背景信息整理的模拟新闻正文，供英语学习使用。)*

Meta Platforms announced on Tuesday that it is launching a new subscription service that bundles enhanced artificial intelligence features, as the social media giant seeks to diversify its revenue streams beyond advertising.

The subscription, which will be rolled out across Meta's family of apps including Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp, gives users access to advanced AI-powered tools such as improved content creation assistants, smarter search capabilities, and priority access to new AI features.

The move places Meta in direct competition with rivals such as OpenAI, which offers ChatGPT Plus, and Google, which provides AI-powered subscription services through Google One. Industry analysts suggest that the AI subscription market could grow significantly in the coming years as companies race to monetize their AI investments.

Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg has repeatedly emphasized that artificial intelligence is the company's top investment priority. The company has spent billions of dollars on AI research and infrastructure, including building massive data centers and developing its own large language models.

The subscription service is expected to be priced competitively, though Meta has not yet disclosed specific pricing details. The company said it would begin rolling out the service in select markets before expanding globally.

## 高频词汇学习

- **subscription** [səbˈskrɪpʃn]
  - n. 名词
  - 订阅；订阅服务
  - 原文例句：Meta launches subscriptions with enhanced AI features.
  - 新闻语境用法：在科技新闻中常指用户按月或按年付费获取数字服务的商业模式，如"subscription-based model"（订阅制模式）。

- **enhanced** [ɪnˈhɑːnst]
  - adj. 形容词
  - 增强的；提高的
  - 原文例句：Meta launches subscriptions with enhanced AI features.
  - 新闻语境用法：常用于描述产品升级或功能改进，如"enhanced features"（增强功能）、"enhanced security"（增强安全性）。

- **artificial intelligence** [ˌɑːtɪˈfɪʃl ɪnˈtelɪdʒəns]
  - n. 名词短语
  - 人工智能
  - 原文例句：...bundles enhanced artificial intelligence features.
  - 新闻语境用法：缩写为AI，是当前科技新闻的核心词汇，常与"powered"连用，如"AI-powered tools"（AI驱动的工具）。

- **diversify** [daɪˈvɜːsɪfaɪ]
  - v. 动词
  - 使多样化；多元化
  - 原文例句：...seeks to diversify its revenue streams beyond advertising.
  - 新闻语境用法：商业新闻高频词，常指企业拓展新业务领域以降低风险，如"diversify revenue streams"（多元化收入来源）。

- **revenue** [ˈrevənjuː]
  - n. 名词
  - 收入；营收
  - 原文例句：...seeks to diversify its revenue streams beyond advertising.
  - 新闻语境用法：财经新闻核心词汇，常见搭配有"revenue growth"（营收增长）、"annual revenue"（年收入）。

- **roll out** [rəʊl aʊt]
  - v. 动词短语
  - 推出；正式发布
  - 原文例句：The subscription will be rolled out across Meta's family of apps.
  - 新闻语境用法：科技和商业新闻中表示产品或服务正式上线的常用表达，名词形式为"rollout"。

- **monetize** [ˈmʌnɪtaɪz]
  - v. 动词
  - 货币化；变现
  - 原文例句：...as companies race to monetize their AI investments.
  - 新闻语境用法：科技商业新闻高频词，指将产品或技术转化为收入，如"monetize user data"（将用户数据变现）。

- **infrastructure** [ˈɪnfrəstrʌktʃə]
  - n. 名词
  - 基础设施
  - 原文例句：The company has spent billions of dollars on AI research and infrastructure.
  - 新闻语境用法：在科技新闻中常指数据中心、服务器等技术基础设施，如"digital infrastructure"（数字基础设施）。

- **competitively** [kəmˈpetətɪvli]
  - adv. 副词
  - 有竞争力地
  - 原文例句：The subscription service is expected to be priced competitively.
  - 新闻语境用法：商业新闻中描述定价策略，如"priced competitively"（定价有竞争力），暗示价格低于或等同于竞争对手。

- **disclose** [dɪsˈkləʊz]
  - v. 动词
  - 披露；公开
  - 原文例句：Meta has not yet disclosed specific pricing details.
  - 新闻语境用法：新闻中表示官方发布信息的正式用词，常用于"disclose details/information"（披露细节/信息）。

## 重点表达解析

- **launches subscriptions with enhanced AI features**
  - 含义：推出带有增强AI功能的订阅服务
  - 使用场景：科技新闻标题中常用的"launch + 产品 + with + 特色功能"结构，简洁有力地概括新闻要点
  - 例句：Apple launches new iPad with enhanced display technology.（苹果推出搭载增强显示技术的新款iPad。）

- **diversify revenue streams beyond advertising**
  - 含义：使收入来源多元化，不再仅仅依赖广告
  - 使用场景：商业新闻中描述企业战略转型，减少对单一收入来源的依赖
  - 例句：The media company is trying to diversify its revenue streams beyond advertising by investing in e-commerce.（该媒体公司正试图通过投资电商来多元化收入来源，不再仅依赖广告。）

- **places Meta in direct competition with rivals**
  - 含义：使Meta与竞争对手形成直接竞争
  - 使用场景：商业新闻中描述市场竞争格局，常用"place A in competition with B"结构
  - 例句：The new product places the startup in direct competition with industry giants.（这款新产品使该初创公司与行业巨头形成直接竞争。）

- **race to monetize their AI investments**
  - 含义：竞相将AI投资变现
  - 使用场景：描述科技公司之间激烈的商业化竞争，"race to"表示争先恐后做某事
  - 例句：Tech companies are racing to monetize their cloud computing investments.（科技公司正竞相将云计算投资变现。）

- **begin rolling out the service in select markets before expanding globally**
  - 含义：先在部分市场推出服务，然后再全球扩展
  - 使用场景：科技新闻中描述产品发布策略，常见的分阶段推广模式
  - 例句：The company will begin rolling out the feature in select markets before expanding globally.（该公司将先在部分市场推出该功能，然后再全球扩展。）

## 阅读理解练习

**1. What is Meta's main purpose of launching the subscription service with AI features?**

A. To replace its advertising business entirely
B. To diversify its revenue streams beyond advertising
C. To compete with social media platforms like TikTok

答案：B

**2. Which of the following is NOT mentioned as part of Meta's family of apps?**

A. Facebook
B. Instagram
C. Twitter

答案：C

**3. According to the article, what has Meta NOT yet disclosed about the subscription service?**

A. The specific pricing details
B. The AI features included
C. The apps it will be available on

答案：A
